subject: microbiology
title: Nocardia, Modified Acid-Fast Staining and Actinomycetes

steps.tx: **Nocardia** species are aerobic branching filamentous bacteria from soil and decaying matter, weakly gram positive beaded filaments fragmenting to rods, **modified acid fast** positive (mycolic acids shorter than mycobacteria, decolorised by 1 percent sulfuric not strong acid alcohol), inhaled to lungs of immunocompromised hosts and inoculated to skin of gardeners.
steps.say: Branching, aerobic, weakly acid fast: Nocardia sits between Actinomyces and tuberculosis on the bench.

left.title: Organism portrait
points: Aerial hyphae chalky colonies days later
Modified ZN with 1 percent acid positive
Soil, dust and water biofilms source

right.title: Host terrain
points: Steroids, transplant, HIV low CD4, anti TNF

steps.tx: **Nocardiosis syndromes** run pulmonary (subacute pneumonia, nodules, cavitation, empyema mimicking TB and malignancy), disseminated (brain abscesses classically multiple, skin lesions), cutaneous (sporotrichoid lymphocutaneous, mycetoma grains), and eye, with brain imaging mandatory in pulmonary disease of the immunocompromised because silent abscess changes duration.
steps.say: Lung Nocardia earns a brain scan; silent abscesses set the treatment calendar.

left.title: Pulmonary portrait
points: Weeks of cough, fever, weight loss

steps.tx: **Nocardia therapy** anchors on co trimoxazole (sulfonamides historically) with susceptibility guided partners (imipenem, amikacin, linezolid near universal, ceftriaxone, minocycline), combinations in severe and CNS disease, six to twelve months duration, longer in immunocompromise, species predicting patterns (farcinica resistant reputation).
steps.say: Sulphonamide anchor, combination for brain, year for the immunocompromised: Nocardia therapy arithmetic.

left.title: Regimen logic
points: Add imipenem or amikacin severe and CNS
Linezolid reliable but toxicity long courses

steps.tx: **Laboratory handling for Nocardia** needs warning the bench: slow growth on routine media (2 days to 2 weeks), colonies dismissed as diphtheroid or contaminant, selective media (Thayer Martin even, paraffin baiting heritage), hold cultures in chronic lung and immunocompromised specimens, modified ZN requested explicitly.
steps.say: Telephone the laboratory or Nocardia is discarded as skin before it grows.

nodes.label: Laboratory warned: hold cultures, modified ZN
Chalky colonies in days to weeks
MALDI and sequencing speciation and referral susceptibilities

steps.tx: **Mycetoma fork** (actinomycetoma by Nocardia, Streptomyces and Actinomadura versus eumycetoma by fungi) reads grains by colour and filaments by width and acid fastness, therapy diverging antibiotics versus antifungals plus surgery. Tropical foot swelling with sinuses earns grain examination before empirical choices.
steps.say: Grains again: thin acid fast filaments take antibiotics, broad fungal hyphae take antifungals.

steps.tx: **Rhodococcus, Gordonia and Tsukamurella** are Nocardia's aerobic acid fast cousins (Rhodococcus equi foal pathogen causing cavitary pneumonia in advanced HIV, weakly acid fast coccobacilli, combination therapy), aerobic actinomycete bench reports increasingly speciated by MALDI and sequencing.
steps.say: Rhodococcus in advanced HIV cavitates like TB and Nocardia combined in differential.

steps.tx: **Modified acid fast technique** (1 percent sulfuric acid decoloriser instead of acid alcohol, or Kinyoun weak protocols) separates Nocardia and Rhodococcus from fully acid fast mycobacteria, a single reagent dilution carrying genus weight, and Gram stain beading adds the first clue from sputum.
steps.say: Weaker acid, weaker mycolic wall: one dilution separates Nocardia from tuberculosis.

left.title: Stain ladder
points: Legionella micdadei tissue modified positive curiosity
Cryptosporidium modified ZN on stool (parasite module)

right.title: Bench sequence
points: HIV and immune status asked from chart

steps.tx: **Streptomyces and Actinomadura** complete actinomycetes (soil filaments, mycetoma and rare invasive), Streptomyces famous as antibiotic producers (streptomycin, tetracyclines, macrolides ancestry) infecting seldom. The order that medicated the century occasionally needs its own medicines.
steps.say: Streptomyces gave the antibiotic era and occasionally asks for it back.

right.title: Actinomadura
points: Madurae and pelletieri mycetomas (red grains pelletieri)
Thermophilic compost kin (farmer lung antigens separate)
